tasks.title: ZionTools — tool schemas (OpenAI + Anthropic envelopes)
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/ZionTools.swift with `struct ZionTools` defining 6 tools: read, edit, write, bash, grep, glob. Each tool has a stable JSON Schema. Two exporters: `static func toolSchemasJSON() -> [[String: Any]]` returns OpenAI shape `{type:'function', function:{name, description, parameters: JSONSchema}}`; `static func anthropicToolSchemas() -> [[String: Any]]` returns Anthropic shape `{name, description, input_schema}`. Edit tool MUST mirror Anthropic text_editor_20250728 str_replace semantics — params: `path: String, edits: [{oldText: String, newText: String}]`. Read: `path, offset?, limit?`. Write: `path, content`. Bash: `command, timeout?`. Grep: `pattern, path?, glob?, ignoreCase?`. Glob: `pattern, path?`. Write Tests/ZionTests/ZionToolsTests.swift: assert toolSchemasJSON returns 6 entries, all with required JSONSchema fields; assert anthropicToolSchemas envelope differs (no `function` wrapper, uses `input_schema` not `parameters`); assert edit schema contains oldText + newText keys.
criteria: grep -E 'static func toolSchemasJSON|static func anthropicToolSchemas' Sources/Zion/Services/ZionTools.swift | wc -l

tasks.title: IntentClassifier + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/IntentClassifier.swift with `enum HarnessIntent: Equatable { case lastCommit; case currentChanges; case recentHistory; case status; case fileContent(path: String); case commitDetails(sha: String) }` + `static func classify(_ text: String) -> HarnessIntent?`. Regex/keyword based, line-anchored, conservative (return nil unless high confidence). Match EN + PT-BR phrasings: 'last commit'/'ultimo commit'/'latest commit' → .lastCommit; 'current changes'/'what changed'/'que mudou'/'uncommitted'/'my changes' → .currentChanges; 'history'/'historico'/'recent commits'/'ultimos commits' → .recentHistory; 'status'/'estado do repo'/'staged'/'working tree' → .status; pattern '(show|read|abre|veja|ver|explica|review) <path>' where path matches `\S+\.\w+` → .fileContent(path); pattern '(commit|sha) <7-40 hex>' → .commitDetails(sha). Conservative — must NOT match 'what is SSE?' or unrelated text. Write Tests/ZionTests/IntentClassifierTests.swift: >=12 assertions covering each intent positive EN + positive PT-BR + negative/ambiguous nil.

tasks.title: ZionHarness actor + FileMutationQueue + tests
tasks.description: Create Sources/Zion/Services/ZionHarness.swift with `actor ZionHarness { let worker: RepositoryWorker; let repoURL: URL; private var sessionReadFiles: Set<URL>; private let mutationQueue: FileMutationQueue; func execute(toolCall: ToolCall) async -> ToolResult; func resetSession() }`. Includes `struct ToolCall { let id: String; let name: String; let arguments: [String: Any] }`, `struct ToolResult { let toolCallID: String; let content: String; let isError: Bool }`, `enum HarnessError: Error`. Nested `private actor FileMutationQueue` keyed by absolute path (serializes writes/edits to same path). Hard rules: (a) edit on path not in sessionReadFiles → error chat.tool.error.readBeforeEdit; (b) write on existing path → error chat.tool.error.fileExists; (c) bash command must match `^(git|swift|ls|pwd|cat|echo)\s` regex else chat.tool.error.bashNotAllowed; (d) all paths resolved via URL.resolvingSymlinksInPath().standardized must hasPrefix repoURL.standardized → else chat.tool.error.outsideRepo; (e) read adds to sessionReadFiles. Honor @AppStorage('chat.allowEdits') default false (read via UserDefaults.standard — actor context). Read: cap 8000 lines / 1MB, return truncation marker. Bash: cap 100 lines / 1MB, spill to tmp file with marker. Write Tests/ZionTests/ZionHarnessTests.swift with these scenarios: test_edit_rejected_without_prior_read, test_write_rejected_when_file_exists, test_bash_allowlist_enforced (positive git status + negative rm -rf), test_path_outside_repo_rejected (../etc/passwd + symlink), test_file_mutation_queue_serializes, test_session_reset_on_new_thread, test_edit_empty_oldText_rejected, test_edit_text_not_found_returns_context. Use temp git repo via FileManager.temporaryDirectory + Process to git init.

tasks.title: ChatService tool-streaming loop + intent fallback + tests
tasks.description: Modify Sources/Zion/Services/ChatService.swift: inject `@ObservationIgnored private let harness: ZionHarness` via init (update both prod + test init signatures). In send(): read @AppStorage('chat.toolsEnabled') default true, 'chat.allowEdits' default false, 'chat.autoInject' default true via UserDefaults.standard.bool(forKey:) (since ChatService is @Observable not view). Compute `useTools = toolsEnabled && provider.supportsToolCalling`. If useTools: call provider stream-with-tools variant with ZionTools.toolSchemasJSON() (or anthropicToolSchemas() for .anthropic). Loop max 10 hops: for each StreamEvent — textDelta → append to last assistant message; toolCallStart → append ChatToolEvent(status: running) to message.toolEvents; toolCallComplete → await harness.execute(toolCall), append result as assistant tool_result content + update toolEvent status. After 10 hops: append `{error: max_hops_exceeded}` synthetic tool result, force one final non-tool call. If !useTools: if autoInject on, call IntentClassifier.classify(originalUserText); if hit, run command via worker (git show HEAD --patch / git diff HEAD / etc), prepend fenced output to expandedText, set user message.autoInjectedIntent = intent label string. newThread() calls await harness.resetSession(). Write Tests/ZionTests/ChatServiceToolLoopTests.swift: test_full_tool_loop (mock provider yields tool call → harness mocked → assistant text), test_max_hops_enforced (mock yields 11 calls → maxHops error), test_auto_injection_when_no_tools (gemini provider + 'last commit' message → autoInjectedIntent set + fenced block present), test_settings_toggles_respected (toolsEnabled false → no tool loop, allowEdits false → edit rejected with editsDisabled error). Use injected streamProvider seam.
